correctness.rationale: Any H-fixed point has constant barycentric weight per H-orbit, so its exact geometric fixed complex is orbit-face. Rotational orbits are residues mod d; d=1 empty, d=2 S0, d>=3 ordinary Ind2(C_d), whose modulo-four homotopy types are Deshpande-Singh Theorem 4.6. Reflection folds residues into interval length ell; forbidden triple/endpoint pair constraints yield F_ell. The first-full-pair toggle matching, followed when odd ell by last-vertex toggle, has all pairs within F_ell\K_ell and a decreasing-cardinality elementary-collapse order; residual K_ell is join of floor(ell/2) copies of S0, giving S^{floor(ell/2)-1}. I independently compared orbit face sets and folding models for n3..14 all divisors and parity axes, and inspected source checker including finite relative acyclicity. These checks corroborate the complete symbolic collapse and boundaries, not extrapolation.
